notes: QxL is a rasterizer/waveform-monitor test instrument (IP/SDI signal generator, analyzer & monitor), not a typical AV signal-chain device — no category/type in the given enums fits well, so "other"/"Other" was used. Base standard unit ships with NO SDI BNC I/O: only 2x SFP28 (25GE/10GE, standard) + optional 2x QSFP28 cages for ST 2110/2022-6 IP video. A factory-fitted "SDI option" adds 4x SDI BNC inputs (SDI In A-D) and 4x SDI BNC outputs (SDI Out A-D), each HD/3G/6G/12G-SDI capable, plus 2x SFP+ cages for 12G SDI over fiber/copper (SFP+A/B). This device entry models the SDI-option-fitted configuration since it is the more common/complete deployment; the standard (non-SDI) unit omits ports 1-4 in the list below. QSFP28 has no exact match in the connector enum; mapped to "sfp" as closest available id — actual physical form factor is QSFP28 (100GbE-class), speed/grade not confirmed in manual text (image-only table), so no grade set. SFP28 ports (E/F) are used for ST 2110/2022-6 IP video over 10GbE/25GbE — mapped to "sfp" with eth-10g grade noted as the confirmed baseline (25G capability also supported but exact negotiated grade depends on SFP module; conservatively using eth-10g). Unit is a desktop instrument; rack-mounting is via optional accessory trays (PHQXK1/2/3), not an intrinsic fixed rack-unit height, so rackUnits omitted per instructions. Power is 4-pin XLR DC input (10-18V, 12V nominal) fed from an external AC/DC power brick supplied with the unit — modeled as xlr4-dc per the connector list. Micro USB rear port is a factory-service-only port (not for general user I/O) but included for completeness as bidirectional.

ports.note: Analyzer SDI input; 75R BNC; factory-fitted SDI option. Supports HD/3G/6G/12G-SDI.

ports.note: Analyzer SDI input; 75R BNC; factory-fitted SDI option. Supports HD/3G/6G/12G-SDI.

ports.name: SDI Out A
ports.note: Generator / duplicate SDI / input-SDI loop output; 75R BNC; factory-fitted SDI option. Supports HD/3G/6G/12G-SDI.

ports.name: SDI Out B
ports.note: Generator / duplicate SDI / input-SDI loop output; 75R BNC; factory-fitted SDI option. Supports HD/3G/6G/12G-SDI.

ports.name: SDI Out C
ports.note: Generator / duplicate SDI / input-SDI loop output; 75R BNC; factory-fitted SDI option. Supports HD/3G/6G/12G-SDI.

ports.name: SDI Out D
ports.note: Generator / duplicate SDI / input-SDI loop output; 75R BNC; factory-fitted SDI option. Supports HD/3G/6G/12G-SDI.

ports.name: SFP+ A
ports.note: MSA/Non-MSA 12GbE copper or fiber SFP+ cage carrying 12G-SDI over fiber/coax; factory-fitted SDI option.

ports.name: SFP+ B
ports.note: MSA/Non-MSA 12GbE copper or fiber SFP+ cage carrying 12G-SDI over fiber/coax; factory-fitted SDI option.

ports.name: SFP28 E
ports.note: Standard-fit 25GE/10GE SFP28 cage for ST 2110 / ST 2022-6 IP video (decapsulation/receive in 2022-6 mode). Module-dependent; also supports 25G.

ports.name: SFP28 F
ports.note: Standard-fit 25GE/10GE SFP28 cage for ST 2110 / ST 2022-6 IP video (encapsulation/transmit in 2022-6 mode). Module-dependent; also supports 25G.

ports.name: QSFP28 C
ports.note: Optional QSFP28 cage for high-density IP video (2110/2022-6). No exact QSFP28 id in connector list; mapped to sfp as closest match. Speed/grade not confirmed in available manual text.

ports.name: QSFP28 D
ports.note: Optional QSFP28 cage for high-density IP video (2110/2022-6). No exact QSFP28 id in connector list; mapped to sfp as closest match. Speed/grade not confirmed in available manual text.

ports.name: Reference IO (REF)
ports.note: 75-ohm Mini-BNC external locking reference input; tri-level or bi-level (black burst) sync, 50/59.94/60 Hz. Physically a mini-BNC; mapped to bnc as closest available connector id.

ports.name: SDI Copy Instrument Output (SDI OUT)
ports.note: 75-ohm Mini-BNC instrument monitor output, 3G-SDI, 1080p50/59.94/60. Physically mini-BNC; mapped to bnc as closest available connector id.

ports.name: HDMI Instrument Output
ports.note: Type A, HDMI v1.4, outputs up to 1920x1080p50/59.94/60 RGB 4:4:4, 4x PCM stereo audio at 48kHz; monitor output for instrument panels.

ports.name: I/O Expansion (D26)
ports.note: 26-way high-density D-type connector carrying 4x bidirectional AES I/O (75-ohm unbalanced), 8x GPI I/O, LTC input (RS-422 compatible), and stereo analog audio output. No D-sub/D-type id exists in the connector enum; euroblock used as a rough placeholder for a multi-signal breakout connector — actual connector is a 26-pin high-density D-sub, not a real euroblock.

ports.name: Control Network / Management Port
ports.note: 1000 Base-T (IEEE 802.3), RJ-45, for remote access/control and NTP.

ports.name: USB (rear)
ports.note: USB 2.0 Type A, rear-mounted (1 of 3 total USB ports; other 2 are front-mounted). For keyboard/mouse control and software installation.

ports.name: Micro USB (Factory Service)
ports.note: Rear-panel Micro USB port reserved for factory service use.

ports.name: AC Power Socket
ports.note: 4-pin male XLR DC power input, 10-18V (12V DC nominal), 50W nominal / 70W max. Powered via an external AC/DC power adapter supplied with the unit (unit itself takes DC, not mains AC, despite panel label 'AC Power Socket').
